
```jsx
import { CxImage } from '@chassis-ui/react'
// or
import CxImage from '@chassis-ui/react/src/react/src/components/image/CxImage'
```

| Property | Description | Type | Default |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| **align** | Set the horizontal aligment. | `'start'` \| `'center'` \| `'end'` \| `undefined` | - |
| **className** | A string of all className you want applied to the component. | `string` \| `undefined` | - |
| **fluid** | Make image responsive. | `boolean` \| `undefined` | - |
| **rounded** | Make image rounded. | `boolean` \| `undefined` | - |
| **thumbnail** | Give an image a rounded 1px border appearance. | `boolean` \| `undefined` | - |
